sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - Marketplace FBA Store

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - US-influenced Common Law corporate statutes (Delaware-modeled Business Corporations Act) with customary law elements
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (1986; Amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force 2020
No comprehensive Double Taxation Agreement in force for e-commerce income; non-resident BC corporate income is tax-exempt within the RMI domestic regime

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (Title 24, Marshall Islands Revised Code), as amended, including beneficial ownership record-keeping duties imposed on licensed Registered Agents; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000 and its AML/CFT Regulations (establishing the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)); Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act 2002; Proliferation Financing (Prohibition) Act 2015. The RMI is a member of the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG). UBO information is maintained by the licensed Registered Agent and is accessible to the FIU and the Registrar of Corporations upon lawful demand; no public UBO register exists.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of UBO passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or civil registry of UBO jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization if the originating state is not a Hague Convention party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: RMI Registrar of Corporations via licensed Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by RMI competent authority OR Consular Legalization by RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Incorporation (notarized)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed RMI Registered Agent or corporate counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for foreign bank and marketplace platform KYC acceptance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency and Registered Agent Certificate (post-filing)
Bank reference letter from UBO primary operating account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank in UBO country of tax residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized officer signature followed by Apostille or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (post-incorporation) for payment-rail onboarding
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via RMI competent authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, corporate officers, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HMT sanctions list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and RMI domestic designations under the Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act 2002. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) require enhanced due diligence with verified source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation per FATF Recommendation 12 and the RMI Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000. Adverse media screening and continuous transaction monitoring apply; records must be retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry - Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Ministry of Commerce, Majuro), administered through licensed Registered Agents and the authorized online filing portal of International Registries, Inc. (IRI)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in the English alphabet. No Marshallese-language name is required. A non-Latin script trade name used on Amazon FBA listings or payment rails must be transliterated into Latin characters; such a name is not registered at the RMI registry level but may be adopted as an assumed name only if filed with the Registrar and after a trademark conflicts search in each marketplace jurisdiction.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservation is filed through a licensed RMI Registered Agent. If the Registrar rejects a name for confusing similarity, prohibited tokens, or non-compliance with the naming rules, the applicant may: (a) re-file a modified name within five business days at the standard reservation fee; (b) submit a written appeal with a legal memorandum to the Registrar within 21 days demonstrating distinguishability and attaching the prior written consent of the existing name holder or the relevant ministerial license for restricted tokens; (c) escalate the appeal to the Chief Registrar and the Minister of Commerce for administrative reconsideration; and (d) if constitutional or jurisdictional grounds exist, seek judicial review at the RMI High Court. The 30-day reservation period is not automatically stayed during the appeal; a fresh reservation fee applies to any extension beyond the initial window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible at RMI statutory level. A non-resident Business Corporation must continuously maintain a registered office at the address of its licensed Registered Agent; the agent's office serves as the legal seat for service of process and no physical staff presence in the Marshall Islands is required. Caveat: commercial counterparty substance thresholds (Amazon seller verification, Stripe, Airwallex, and downstream bank KYC) require a demonstrable operating nexus such as a stable corporate email, transaction records, and auditable financial trail, but these do not constitute an RMI taxable presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk tier: estimated probability below 2% per annum of unannounced physical inspection for a standard non-resident e-commerce BC (ISIC 4791) with clean sanctions status and timely FIU filings. Probability rises to 15-25% if the entity becomes subject to FIU regulatory action, adverse media, or a suspicious transaction report.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA), as amended, Sections 7-10 (incorporation), 82 (registered office), 56-58 (officers and directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) submitted to the Registrar of Corporations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shares may be issued for any lawful consideration authorized by the board. No escrow account requirement for non-resident business corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation approves and adopts the subscription for shares by the initial subscribers as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation in the Marshall Islands be established at the address of the appointed registered agent, and that the registered agent be retained; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the persons named in the organizational documents be appointed as the initial directors and officers, with full authority to manage the affairs of the Corporation; FURTHER RESOLVED, that corporate seals, bank accounts, and operational mandates be established as necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Name Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Online Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a corporate name availability search on the Registrar's e-filing system. Submit a Name Reservation Request indicating the proposed exact corporate name and desired suffix (e.g., 'Corporation', 'Inc.'). Pay the nominal reservation fee online. Obtain the reservation certificate before filing Articles.
required_dossiers: Copy of duly submitted online application acknowledgment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for confusing similarity, amend the proposed name by adding a distinguishing element or filing a written appeal with the Registrar for administrative review, subject to a revised filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and Authorized Marshall Islands Notary / Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in English, including the corporate name, principal office address, registered agent name and address, authorized shares, director names, and any lawful purposes. Have the incorporator or authorized representative sign the Articles before a notary public or registered agent in accordance with BCA Section 8. Ensure the document is certified by the resident registered agent.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Consent to act as registered agent (Form RA-1)
Consent to act as director (Form DIR-1)
Government-issued ID and address proof for each incorporator and director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries missing information or signature deficiencies, cure by filing a Supplementary Amendment or applying for a Certificate of Correction, with revised notarized pages and the applicable correction fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Registration Payment with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Business Registry Submission Counter / e-Registry Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles of Incorporation, registered agent consent, director consents, and the completed filing transmittal to the Business Registry. Pay the statutory incorporation fee via wire transfer, bank draft, or online payment gateway. Obtain the dated receipt referencing the file number.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Evidence of wire transfer or fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If filing is rejected for deficiencies, resubmit plain or conformed copies of all noted documents within 30 days, with an explanatory cover letter and resubmission fee of USD 100. If rejected for nonpayment, attach the bank receipt and re-submit under the original file number.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Incorporation and Certified Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations — Certification Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After successful vetting, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and a certified copy of the Articles, inclusive of the company file number. Request any required apostille (for non-resident use) from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Verify that the certificate bears the seal and authorized signature.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical or legal inconsistencies, request a Certificate of Correction from the Registrar by filing the error notice and paying the amendment fee of USD 75.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Bylaws Adoption and Officer Election
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Board and Corporate Secretary / Compliance Officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting either by written consent or in person. Adopt the corporate bylaws, issue share certificates to subscribers, elect officers, establish the corporate bank account, and approve the initial resolutions regarding online marketplace operations. Minutes and resolutions must be maintained in the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: Share issuance record and share certificate stub
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If corporate records are incomplete or rejected by banking authorities, hold an additional special meeting to ratify all prior acts and execute conforming minutes, certified by the corporate secretary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — Marshall Islands does not license online retail/marketplace FBA enterprises engaged solely in non-resident digital transactions.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or operating permit required for ISIC 4791 (Retail Sale via Internet) in the absence of physical premises in the Marshall Islands.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no EIA required absent local warehousing, manufacturing, or material resource extraction activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no wastewater, VOC, or waste discharge generated in the Marshall Islands from online FBA administrative operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no physical workplace, fire safety, structural load, or occupational clearance required for a non-resident registered e-commerce principal.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance — Revenue and Taxation Division (RMI Revenue & Taxation), Majuro; online tax portal: https://www.mirevenue.org; customs administration: Customs Division, Ministry of Finance, Majuro; corporate registry: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Foreign Affairs & Trade, Majuro (access via licensed registered agents).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Business Corporation through a licensed registered agent by filing Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique corporate registration number (the de facto statutory entity identifier). Step 2: File the Non-Resident Corporation Declaration and appoint a resident agent to perfect non-resident exempt status; no RMI TIN, VAT ID, or employer number is issued or required unless the company later employs a resident workforce (triggering Social Security Administration registration) or undertakes physical resident business with gross revenue above USD 50,000 (triggering the domestic 3% Gross Revenue Tax registration). Step 3: For banking, Amazon Seller Central, Stripe, and Airwallex KYC, request a Certificate of Good Standing and an optional Tax Clearance Certificate from the Revenue and Taxation Division confirming the absence of RMI tax liability; the corporate registration number is used wherever a jurisdictional tax reference must be inserted in foreign tax-ID fields.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — non-resident Business Corporation: excluded from the RMI taxing jurisdiction under the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act and Revenue and Taxation Act; exempt from national income tax, gross revenue tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax; extraterritorial Amazon FBA marketplace turnover is not sourced to the RMI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under RMI domestic law — no check-the-box, S-corporation, or hybrid-mismatch election exists. For U.S. federal classification (e.g., FATCA / Section 7701), a Marshall Islands Business Corporation is a per se foreign corporation (Treas. Reg. § 301.7701-2(b)(8)) and cannot make a Form 8832 check-the-box election; default entity-level C-corporation treatment applies for U.S. persons owning the entity.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No RMI VAT/GST/Sales-and-Use Tax regime. Indirect levies are border-only: Import Duty (8% standard ad valorem) plus specific excise duties on alcohol, tobacco, and petroleum, collected by the RMI Customs Division, Ministry of Finance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — the RMI has no VAT/GST registration concept. The only analogous trigger is the USD 50,000 annual gross-revenue threshold for the domestic 3% Gross Revenue Tax, which applies exclusively to resident businesses and never to a non-resident Business Corporation. The RMI uses the United States dollar (USD) as its official currency; no separate local-currency threshold exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — the RMI mandates no e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, government API reporting, or digital stamping. Non-resident e-commerce entities may issue standard commercial invoices following Amazon FBA / marketplace seller practice; no RMI fiscal authorization or clearance is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the RMI levies no VAT/GST and therefore has no export zero-rating or refund mechanism. A non-resident BC's Amazon FBA sales are extraterritorial: inventory is consigned from a third-country origin (e.g., China) directly to foreign fulfillment centers (United States, Europe) and never enters RMI customs territory; no RMI output tax arises, no export claim can be made, and no refund machinery exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: RMI Certificate of Incorporation and Non-Resident Corporation Declaration (Registrar of Corporations, Majuro)
Certificate of Good Standing and optional Tax Clearance Certificate from RMI Revenue & Taxation Division
Commercial invoice / Amazon FBA shipment plan identifying consignor, consignee, and non-RMI fulfillment-center destination
Ocean or airway bill of lading evidencing that the goods never transited RMI customs territory
Destination-country customs entry documentation (e.g., U.S. CBP entry summary (CBP Form 3461/7501) or EU customs import declaration) showing the RMI entity as seller of record
Inward remittance certificate and Amazon disbursement/bank statements substantiating the cross-border proceeds flow (for bank due-diligence only; the RMI imposes no exchange control)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no RMI VAT zero-rating or refund regime to claw back. However, false statements made to secure or preserve non-resident exempt status are punishable under the Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Act and Business Corporations Act by fines of up to USD 10,000, imprisonment, revocation of the tax-exempt classification, and deregistration by the Registrar of Corporations. Separately, incorrect export/import documentation filed for U.S. or EU customs purposes triggers liability under 19 U.S.C. § 1592 (negligence/fraud: penalties up to the dutiable value of merchandise, plus interest and liquidated damages) and may lead to Amazon Seller Central / FBA account termination.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commission of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (banking supervision under the Banking Act 1997); no formal central bank exists; US Federal Reserve System is the de facto monetary anchor because the US dollar is legal tender under the Compact of Free Association
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: USD is the sole legal tender and domestic currency; full convertibility on both current and capital accounts with zero exchange controls, approvals, or licensing requirements; profit remittance and capital repatriation by non-resident Business Corporations are unrestricted; no domestic withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties; no RMI tax filing or foreign exchange declaration applies to a non-resident BC
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable; there is no statutory export proceeds surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio because the local currency is already USD and the RMI imposes no exchange controls; Amazon FBA settlement proceeds received in USD require no conversion, deposit into an RMI or offshore USD account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (standard trust/escrow wrappers for subscribed capital)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low for direct entity onboarding. Stripe does not support Marshall Islands-incorporated businesses for merchant onboarding or payouts. Airwallex does not list RMI on its supported entity jurisdictions; a US/HK/AU intermediate entity is required. Payoneer is highly viable as the practical payout rail for Amazon Seller Central proceeds (Amazon disburses to Payoneer, then onward to the MHC). Legal constraint: all EMIs are unregulated in RMI and permitted only as payment facilitators; the MHC must remain merchant of record and funds must flow in the entity's legal name to avoid characterization as an unlicensed money services operation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person identity verification at a Majuro branch is mandatory for at least one authorized signatory at both BMI and Bank of Guam; fully remote opening is not currently available for foreign-owned, non-resident BCs. A non-resident director may satisfy this by appointing a resident authorized signatory (RMI-licensed registered agent or local CFO) under an apostilled board resolution, but the signatory must appear physically with certified corporate documents. Video KYC and biometric-only remote interviews are not accepted by RMI domestic banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore symmetric BC with non-resident shareholders and no physical substance in the RMI, flagged as a shell-company red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing; full register of directors and shareholders; RMI Business Corporations Act beneficial-ownership declaration; registered agent confirmation; board resolution approving account opening; explanation of the Amazon FBA operating model with supplier and marketplace contracts; monthly management accounts proving economic activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value cross-border ecommerce income routed through third-party payment facilitators (Amazon, Payoneer), giving rise to source-of-funds concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12 months of Amazon Seller Central settlement and payout reports in the MHC's legal name; Payoneer account statements; order-level reconciliation ledger; payment facilitator agreement; confirmation that the entity is not a money service business and receives no crypto or cash flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of a tax identification number or tax filing history, which US correspondent banks may misinterpret as tax non-compliance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official letter from the RMI Banking Commission/Ministry of Finance confirming that non-resident BCs are tax-exempt and that no TIN is issued; IRS Form W-8BENE confirming no US-sourced ECI or FDAP income; registered agent certification; audited or accountant-reviewed financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: China-based supplier disbursements (USD/CNY) that trigger sanctions screening, dual-use goods review, and enhanced payment-screening alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved supplier list with business licenses; commercial invoices and signed purchase orders; HS codes and ecommerce tariff classifications; supplier sanctions and PEP screening output; FBA shipment records (bill of lading/airway bill) and customs entry documents matching each disbursement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital contributions flow via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire through a US correspondent) from the shareholder's bank to the MHC USD operating account at Bank of Marshall Islands; field 50K identifies the remitting shareholder, field 59 states the MHC legal name and IBAN/US account number, and field 70 must state 'Equity capital contribution - issuance of shares under the RMI Business Corporations Act'. No RMI exchange control approval or central bank filing is required. Capital verification is completed by board resolution authorizing issuance, share subscription agreement, and register of members entries; a separate capital escrow account is used only when third-party escrow agents hold funds pre-issuance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail for FBA inventory replenishment is USD-denominated SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer to Chinese or Hong Kong suppliers, with conversion to CNY executed by the beneficiary's bank; typical settlement time is 1-3 business days. For bulk high-value purchase orders, commercial Letters of Credit at sight are issued through Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam, with presentation of commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, and certificate of origin. Amazon marketplace fees, FBA fulfillment charges, and refunds are netted automatically from seller proceeds, requiring no separate wire. Treasury liquidity buffers should be split: 30 days of operational liquidity in the RMI operating account and 60-90 days of reserves held in a US money market or time deposit via Bank of Guam to mitigate clearing latency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNY plain-vanilla deliverable forwards with US or Hong Kong bank counterparties
USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referenced to offshore CNH fixing for RMB exposure
USD/EUR and USD/CNY cross-currency swaps under ISDA/CSA master agreements with investment-grade bank counterparties
Zero-premium FX collar structures to protect inventory purchase costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Corporation Report and Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between January 1 and April 30; final due date April 30 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of 10% of the unpaid franchise tax per month or fraction of a month, capped at 50%; continued non-payment after notice may result in administrative dissolution or strike-off by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit under the RMI Business Corporations Act for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation; financial statements need not be filed or published. An independent audit is triggered only when required by shareholder resolution, the articles of incorporation, a financing counterparty, or a regulated activity license.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory GAAP in the Republic of the Marshall Islands for non-resident exempt corporations; financial statements are commonly prepared in accordance with IFRS or US GAAP as contractually agreed. The Business Corporations Act requires the company to maintain correct books and records.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a current beneficial ownership register and perform an annual compliance review. Each share transfer or change in beneficial ownership triggers a written notification to the agent, and an annual UBO confirmation statement is executed by or on behalf of the directors. No public UBO register is filed with the Registrar; the confirmation is held by the registered agent.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident domestic corporations are wholly exempt from Marshall Islands income tax on foreign-source income; no gross revenue tax, capital gains tax, or branch remittance tax applies. The exemption is available provided the corporation does not carry on business within the Marshall Islands and files the annual registry return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Marshall Islands income tax return is required for exempt non-resident Business Corporations. Annual registry compliance is effected through the 'Annual Report / Government Fee Statement' submitted via the RMI Online Registry System operated by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual report and government fee must be filed by the last day of the calendar month preceding the anniversary month of incorporation (e.g., an entity incorporated in October files by September 30).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 1 - Entity Name and Registry Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The exact registered business corporation name and assigned registry number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input the name as shown in the certificate of incorporation; no U.S. or RMI tax identification number is required for non-resident entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 2 - Registered Office and Resident Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical/registered office in the Marshall Islands and the name and address of the licensed resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the licensed resident agent's Marshall Islands address; foreign addresses cannot be used for the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all directors, principal officer, secretary, and registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be natural persons or corporate entities; no local residence or tax-residence requirement applies; disclose all foreign directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes, par value, number of authorized shares, and issued and outstanding shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual government fee scales with authorized capital; common practice for an Amazon FBA holding entity is USD 50,000 nominal capital or the lowest fee band.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the corporation is a non-resident domestic corporation and has derived no income from Marshall Islands sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign under penalty of false swearing; if the corporation expands into physical RMI operations, the zero-tax status is immediately jeopardized.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a penalty of USD 500 or 10% of the annual government fee, whichever is greater, plus interest. Continued default may result in administrative dissolution after notice, reinstatement fees, and de-registration from payment-facilitator verification processes such as Amazon's W-8 renewal chain.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (statutory rate; dividends distributed by an exempt non-resident Business Corporation are free of Marshall Islands withholding tax)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands generally maintains no comprehensive double tax treaty network; treaty relief is therefore largely inapplicable. Where a foreign jurisdiction gives unilateral credit or a specific agreement treats the RMI entity as a resident, the standard protocol is: (i) request a Certificate of Tax Residence from the RMI Registrar; (ii) submit the certificate together with the applicable Foreign Form W-8BEN-E or local equivalent to the withholding agent; and (iii) provide a beneficial ownership declaration to invoke any reduced rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on royalty and interest paid to non-residents; no RMI source tax is imposed because the non-resident corporation derives no RMI-source income. Treaty rates are likewise 0%; however, mirror withholding may be faced under the payor's domestic law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A - the Marshall Islands levies no corporate income tax and has enacted no transfer pricing documentation statute or Local File/Master File threshold. If a foreign jurisdiction (e.g., IRS or OECD CbCR) requires documentation, the general triggering thresholds are USD 12.5 million gross revenue for a Local File and USD 850 million consolidated group revenue for a Country-by-Country Report.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands has not enacted a standalone Economic Substance Regulations regime analogous to BVI/Guernsey/Isle of Man. Nevertheless, the Business Corporation must demonstrate it is not conducting 'business' within the Republic, construed as business activity within RMI territory. For a remote Amazon FBA operation with no physical RMI presence, the entity may remain tax-exempt but must maintain: (i) a licensed registered agent; (ii) a local registered office; and (iii) a complete set of corporate records. Foreign tax authorities may independently recharacterize substance based on actual management and control locations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in retail operations physically inside the Marshall Islands (e.g., warehousing or inventory stationed in RMI) or deriving income from RMI-sourced customers or payments while continuing to claim the non-resident domestic corporation zero-tax exemption on the annual filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imposition of back taxes under the gross revenue tax regime at the applicable retail rate (up to 7% or other statutory rate) for the relevant years; penalty of 50% of the unpaid tax for fraudulent omission; interest accrual; revocation of the certificate of good standing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign a false tax-exemption declaration are personally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; criminal conviction for perjury carries imprisonment up to 5 years; foreign directors may face an enforceable judgment through the High Court of the Marshall Islands.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Marshall Islands entity as a pure invoice-mill or pass-through vehicle for Amazon marketplace proceeds without economic activity, bank account oversight, or corporate formalities, especially when the beneficial owner resides in a high-tax jurisdiction and the entity is used to disguise actual ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Business Corporations Act the Attorney General may apply for judicial dissolution; the court may order forfeiture of share capital or disgorgement of profits; the Registrar may impose regulatory fines for failure to maintain adequate records in the RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the corporate veil is pierced, directors and shareholders may be jointly and severally liable for company debts and for false representations to payment service providers; directors may be barred from acting as officers for 5 years and, in severe cases, may be imprisoned for fraud under the RMI Criminal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing payments through Amazon Pay, Stripe, or Airwallex without an adequate AML/CFT framework while routing transactions through high-risk territories, or accepting proceeds of prohibited online sales (e.g., controlled goods, cyberfraud proceeds).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Marshall Islands AML/CFT Act criminalizes money laundering with corporate penalties of up to USD 1,000,000 and individual imprisonment up to 15 years; the Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze bank accounts; payment gateways may terminate the merchant agreement and report the seller as high risk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly or negligently allow the platform to be used for money laundering are subject to criminal prosecution, travel bans, extradition risk, and seizure of personal assets; bank indemnity provisions may hold directors personally liable for chargeback fraud or illegal transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting intercompany service fees, IP royalties, or inventory pricing between the Marshall Islands entity and a mainland China, Hong Kong, or United States affiliate at non-arm's-length levels, or failing to report the entity as a controlled foreign corporation on a foreign owner's tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: While the RMI imposes no statutory transfer pricing penalty, foreign revenue authorities (e.g., IRS IRC 482, China SAT, HMRC) may assess upward adjustments, impose 20-40% transfer pricing penalties on the underpaid tax, and disallow the RMI entity's claimed exemption; the entity may also be blacklisted under the OECD's harmful tax practices review.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign manipulated intercompany transfer pricing contracts may be personally liable for restitution if the arrangement is found to be a sham, may face civil asset freezing orders, and in aggravated cases may be subject to extradition for tax fraud; professional advisors may face professional disqualification.
